motion.name: archive-evacuation-spring
motion.purpose: Contract the expanded tile, await spring completion, then move unit tiles to packed destinations and await completion before expansion. Each stage uses duration 0 for reduced motion.

motion.name: archive-expansion-spring
motion.purpose: Grow the newly active tile only after its reserved cells are vacant and settled; interrupted sequences are invalidated.

motion.name: editorial-ease
motion.purpose: 850ms introduction reveal, 300ms dialog entrance, and 400ms detail zoom.

motion.name: underline
motion.purpose: Navigation/filter underlines and directional action feedback.

motion.name: hover-intent
motion.purpose: Pointer intent delay before archive expansion.

narrative.overview:
A European decorative-arts archive translated into an interactive editorial wall. Warm paper, espresso lettering, fine rules, and object photography create a quiet cultural identity with a densely inhabited collection.

The typography pairs a precise sans serif with a restrained italic editorial voice. Surfaces stay flat; physical movement belongs to the collection and its reserved-cell expansion. The heavy LO and fine THUUS lettering remain the identifying brand gesture.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and espresso with restrained brown accents.
Oversized sans serif headlines with italic editorial contrast.
Square, flat surfaces, fine rules, and architectural whitespace.
Object-led density with deliberate, accessible physical motion.

rules.name: The Paper and Ink Rule
rules.body: Use warm paper for the reading ground and espresso for primary content; keep the accent for focus and small signals.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for structure and reading; use the editorial italic for a brief expressive counterpoint. Preserve heavy LO and fine THUUS.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Keep page surfaces flat. Reserve ambient shadow and a blurred backdrop for modal separation.

dos: Do preserve heavy LO and fine THUUS in the wordmark.
Do use fine rules, square containers, and paper-to-ink contrast to establish hierarchy.
Do let expanded objects reserve real layout cells and displace neighboring objects.
Do provide visible focus, keyboard exploration, touch expansion, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't use artificial grain or heavy interface chrome.
Don't turn flat archive tiles into floating shadow cards.
Don't overlay enlarged objects on their neighbors.
Don't use editorial italics for all navigation or body copy.
